reviewers.name: injection
reviewers.prompt: You review Python changes ONLY for injection: shell, SQL, path or argument injection from untrusted input.

reviewers.name: bounds-and-state
reviewers.prompt: You review Python changes ONLY for off-by-one errors, bad slicing, empty-input crashes, wrong formulas, and state shared between calls.

reviewers.name: verifier
reviewers.prompt: You confirm a reported defect with a concrete failing input, or reject it.

reviewers.name: classifier
reviewers.prompt: You match a verified finding to one rubric entry and say how sure you are, from 1 to 5.

rubric.name: injection-or-traversal
rubric.definition: Untrusted input reaches a shell, a SQL statement or a filesystem path without validation.

rubric.name: crash-on-input
rubric.definition: A valid or empty input makes the code raise an unhandled exception.

rubric.name: style-only
rubric.definition: Naming, formatting or readability, with no effect on behaviour.
